# @bun-erp/pdf

> Optional, composable React PDF primitives and themes for client-side document generation.

## Start here
- [Package exports](./package.json)
- [PDF element types](./src/types/)
- [Atomic PDF components](./src/atoms/)
- [Composed components](./src/molecules/)
- [Page components](./src/organisms/)
- [Themes](./src/themes/)
- [Renderer](./src/render.ts)
- [Tests](./tests/)

## Rules for agents
- Load PDF rendering code only from a user-triggered browser flow; keep it out of the Cloudflare Worker entry and initial web route bundle.
- Use the package's explicit subpath exports and existing theme/primitive helpers.
- Keep PDF data generic and supplied by the application feature. Do not invent ERP records or customer-specific copy.
- Verify generated documents in the browser; a successful TypeScript build alone does not confirm layout correctness.
